newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey cancels anti-seizure privatisation article.
newsitem.headline: Turkey cancels anti-seizure privatisation article.

text.p: Turkey's constitutional court on Friday cancelled an article prohibiting the sequestration of all assets owned by state companies whose assets are to be sold off under a privatisation programme.
"Our decision is that the 15th article of the law... breaches the constitution," Yekta Gungor Ozden, head of the constitutional court told reporters after a three-day debate.
The law had taken effect in November 1994 to enable the sell-off of state enterprises or their assets and properties as part of Turkey's privatisation drive.
The 15th article, which was cancelled by the court, had prohibited all proceedings to sequestrate assets of such state institutions.
Separate courts in Turkey had applied to the constitutional court to have the article cancelled.
